editorial:
Imagine a teenage girl who is totally awkward, wears giant braces, and is way too obsessed with true crime. That is exactly who you get with our main lead in this quirky mystery. You will follow her as she takes it upon herself to solve a local disappearance that the adults seem to be ignoring. The vibe is a mix of a coming-of-age story and a lighthearted detective show. It feels like you are hanging out with that one weird kid from school who actually ends up being a genius, making the whole journey feel grounded and funny.

The acting is the real star here, as the lead brings a lot of charm to her socially clumsy character. While the plot is simple, the pacing keeps you moving and the small twists are satisfying. The only downside is that it feels a bit short, like a teaser for a bigger story. If you love light mysteries, you should definitely check it out.
endingExplained: Everything comes together when the awkward sleuth finds the missing person hiding in plain sight. The big twist reveals that the disappearance was actually a cover-up for a family secret. After a tense confrontation, she uses her smarts to expose the truth to everyone. The movie ends with her finally gaining some respect from her peers, proving that being the weird kid can actually be a superpower in the real world.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves teen detectives and quirky humor.
